div.l: But for to telle ȝow of his aray
Hese hors were goode / but he was not gay
Of fustien he werede a iopoıı̄un
Al besloteryd with hese habirioıı̄un
For he was late come frōm hese vyage
And wente for to don here pilgrȳmage
¶ With hȳm þere was / hese sone aȝong squyer Squyer
A louere / ⁊and a lusty bacheleer
With lokkis crulle as þey were leyd in presse
Of twenty ȝer / of age he was I gesse
Of hese stature / he was of euene lenthe
And wonderly delyủere / ⁊and of gret strenthe
And he hadde ben sūmtyme In chyuachie
In Flaıı̄underis in artoys / ⁊and in pikardye
And borȳn wel as of so litil spase
In hope to stondyn / in hese ladygrace
Enbroudit was he / as it were a mede
Al ful of frossche flourys white ⁊and rede
Syngȳnge he was or floutȳnge al the day
He was as frosch as is the monyth of may
Schort was his goūnne / with sleuys longe ⁊and wide
Wel coude he sitte on hors / ⁊and fayre ryde
He coude songis make / ⁊and fayre endite
Iuste ⁊and ek daıı̄unse / ⁊and wel portreye ⁊and wryte
So hote he louede þᵗat be nyghter tale
He slepte no more than doth a nyghtyngale
Curteis he was loueli ⁊and seruysable
And karf be forn hese fadir at the table
¶ A ȝeman hadde he ⁊and seruaıı̄untys no mooȜeman
At that tyme / for he leste ryde soo
And he was clad in cote ⁊and hod of grene
A schef of pekok / arwys bryȝte ⁊and schene
Vndir his belte he bar ful thryftyly
Wel coude he dresse hese takil ȝemanly
Hese arwis droupede nought with federys lowe
And in his hand he bare a myghty bowe
